title: 星舰成功回收：专家称可重复使用近在咫尺，但离太空数据中心还有多远？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Ross, I don't even know how much youthfulness it is to even go through some of the numbers on a quarterly basis backwards looking.
segments.zh: 罗斯，我甚至不知道要回顾季度数据需要多大的年轻心态。

segments.en: I know a lot of investors are looking to figure out kind of whether starship sort of fulfills that promise and whether what's going to be attached to these rockets, presumably whatever
segments.zh: 我知道很多市场参与者都在关注星舰能否兑现承诺，以及这些火箭上会搭载什么，大概是某种服务器或其他轨道数据中心设备。

segments.en: sort of servers and other sort of orbital data center type of equipment are going to be along for the ride sometime soon.
segments.zh: 这些设备可能很快就会随火箭一起升空。

segments.en: Well, I think it's going to be sooner than what people think judging from the last starship flight that we saw, which I would consider pretty successful and when you look at the size
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为这比人们想象的要快，从我们上次看到的星舰飞行来看，我认为那是相当成功的。

segments.en: of this thing and the fact that they're now getting it in and out of space without exploding and landing pretty well into the water, we're pretty close to having a reusable
segments.zh: 当你看到这个庞然大物，以及他们现在能顺利进出太空、没有爆炸并平稳落水，我们离可重复使用的巨型火箭已经很近了。

segments.en: massive rocket ship other than many of the technology challenges that they still face to get this to work, let's say over and over again in scale.
segments.zh: 尽管仍面临许多技术挑战，要让它反复大规模运行，但能走到这一步本身就非常鼓舞人心。

segments.en: But just the fact that they've gotten this far is very encouraging and I don't think people should doubt whether or not this is actually going to happen, it's just wet.
segments.zh: 人们不应该怀疑这件事能否实现，只是时间问题。

segments.en: Yeah, and I think that seems to be the consensus and we've certainly seen some degree of approval life with regards to that ship.
segments.zh: 是的，这似乎是共识，我们也确实看到了对该飞船一定程度的认可。

segments.en: The question now becomes in terms of monetizing this further beyond just being sort of a taxi service if you will into space.
segments.zh: 现在的问题是如何进一步商业化，而不仅仅是作为进入太空的出租车服务。
